title: Rhoform Lockfile v0
description: rhoform.lock, the workspace's one lockfile (spec/language/08-packages.md, The lockfile; R14a L1/L4, D1, I2/I3). It sits at the compile root and holds up to three sections that share one framing: every section is {inputs, entries}, an input is a file's path and the sha256 of its exact bytes, and a section is stale when an input it records is missing or its bytes changed. The file's bytes MUST equal json.dumps(document, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) plus one LF, which JavaScript's JSON.stringify(sorted, null, 2) also writes; the order of every array, the uniqueness of every selector, and each entry naming an input of its own section are invariants this schema cannot state, checked by rhoform/lockfile.py. This file is immutable once released: a later version adds lockfile.v1.schema.json, as the IR does.

^x_.description: Reserved for annotations no compiler reads, such as a schema-gate negative control's declaration. rhoform/lockfile.py refuses every one, so a lockfile a compilation reads holds none: a member that changed nothing would read as if it did.

lockfile_version.description: This document's version. A reader refuses a version it does not implement.

packages.description: Package resolution (R14a L5): each package a compilation of the workspace reads, and the manifests that governed resolving it. Written only by `rhoform pkg lock`, which does not exist yet.

parts.description: D1 part picks: the part record each `part "key"` names, and the record picked for an instance's `part abstract`. Written only by `rhoform parts pin/unpin` (R28).

renames.description: The I2 rename ledger. Its shape is fixed now; every entry is refused until R27 applies the ledger.

Sha256.description: Algorithm-prefixed lowercase hex SHA-256, the IR's hash spelling.

InputPath.description: A relative POSIX path: segments joined by `/`, none empty, `.` or `..`, and no backslash or control character. A path beginning `rhoform/` names a file bundled with the toolchain (its part store), as the source map's `rhoform/lib/` paths do; any other is relative to the compile root.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the file's exact bytes.

Inputs.description: Sorted bytewise by path, each path once.

PackageName.description: A package name (R14a N1, N2, N4).

Version.description: A SemVer 2.0.0 version with no build metadata (R14a V1, V2).

PackageDirectory.description: A package root relative to the compile root, as an input path is; `.` is the compile root itself.

version.description: The version the package's manifest declares.

source.description: Where the package is read from: a path dependency's package root. Version 0 has no other source, as the manifest admits none (spec 08).

manifest.description: The package's rhoform.toml, one of the section's inputs.

requires_rhoform.description: The range of language versions the resolution admits for this package: contained in the package's own `requires-rhoform` (R14a L5, L8).

content_hash.description: The canonical-archive content hash of the package (R14a T2, G8-G10). The archive is not built yet, so the slot is null and `unavailable_reason` says why; a value is refused, since nothing could verify it.

unavailable_reason.description: Why `content_hash` is null. Present exactly when it is.

inputs.description: Every rhoform.toml that took part in resolution.

entries.description: Sorted bytewise by name, each name once.

Echo.description: A value the picked record states, echoed so the lockfile reads on its own; it must equal the record's.

DefinitionName.description: The IR `definition` of a design's root instance: the design a pick or a ledger entry belongs to.

record.description: The picked record, one of the section's inputs.

constraints.description: The digest of the instance's part constraints when it was picked, over their exact decimal values (spec 08); a different digest now is a stale pick.

record.description: The picked record, one of the section's inputs.

inputs.description: The part records the picks name.

entries.description: Keyed picks first, sorted by key, then instance picks, sorted by design and then instance; each selector once.

inputs.description: Reserved for R27's identity baseline; empty in version 0.

entries.description: Sorted by design and then path; within a design each path and each origin once, and no path its own origin.
